gallery.title: File:Nikolaos Kalliakis (1645 - 1707).jpg
gallery.description: Engraved portrait of Nicholas Kalliakis (Greek: Νικόλαος Καλλιάκης, Nikolaos Kalliakis) (Nicolai Calliachius), (c. 1645 - May 8, 1707) was a Greek scholar and philosopher who flourished in Italy in the 17th century. He was appointed doctor of philosophy and theology in Rome, university professor of Greek and Latin and Aristotelian philosophy at Venice in 1666 and professor of belles-lettres and rhetoric at Padua in 1667.

gallery.title: File:Atlante Neroni - Candia.jpg
gallery.artist: Attributed to Matteo Neroni. Formerly attributed to Francesco de Marchi.
gallery.description: One of the plans of cities and fortresses in the Atlante Neroni of 1602. The Atlante Neroni consists of 175 colored illuminated panels of the fortified walls of Italian and European cities, of the Mediterranean basin and of some theaters of war of the campaigns against the Turks. Many maps date from well before 1602.
